notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the game could freeze when moving from Stage 2 to Stage 3, preventing entry into the next stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the active item gauge’s shine effect could stop when moving maps or using the inventory while the gauge was charging.[/p][/*][/list][p]We will continue to improve the game for a smoother play experience.

notes.title: 0923 LootMage Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p][/p][p]Performance & Optimization[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where a brief frame drop occurred when entering the boss room.[/p][/*][/list][p]UI & Controls[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/a9dd7ef49f64533286b7022ba4f2b24814a5f360.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Mouse cursor design and active gauge have been improved.[/p][list][*][p]In UI/menus, the cursor is now displayed as an arrow.[/p][/*][*][p]During gameplay, a clearer crosshair cursor design is applied.[/p][/*][*][p]When the gauge is fully charged, an effect will appear on the cursor for easier recognition.[/p][/*][*][p]Clearing all enemies in a room will now instantly refill the active gauge.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Synergy Adjustments[/p][list][*][p]Nature (6) effect has been changed:[/p][list][*][p]Previous: Tree Spirits no longer disappeared when taking damage, and 1 additional Tree Spirit was summoned at the start of battle.[/p][/*][*][p]Changed: Tree Spirits now survive longer, and 1 additional Tree Spirit is still summoned at the start of battle.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]Nature synergy (overall)[/p][list][*][p]Added: Tree Spirit attack power has been slightly increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Active Items[/p][list][*][p]Some active item effects have been adjusted:[/p][list][*][p]Scroll – Mana Bomb: Explosion radius increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Scroll – Gold Explosion: Explosion damage slightly increased.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/6d7732dc921869df69d232dbb57b4dca261cbe3a.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]A new active item has been added:[/p][list][*][p]Scroll – Fireball[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where Tree Spirits and Ice Spirits continued to attack during boss summon cutscenes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Pierce Arc effect was incorrectly applied to enemy projectiles.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Developer Message[/h3][p][/p][p]It has already been nearly two weeks since LootMage launched in Early Access.[/p][p]As mentioned in the improvement plan shared on September 15, we promised to first address the early-game pacing issue and the limited usefulness of melee weapons. The early pacing issue has now been somewhat improved, and we are also working on adjustments to improve melee combat.[/p][p]In addition, we are preparing the following updates:[/p][list][*][p]Additional rewards for boss battles and enhanced boss attack patterns[/p][/*][*][p]New active items and weapon items[/p][/*][*][p]Various gimmick-based passive items[/p][/*][/list][p]We greatly appreciate your interest and support for LootMage.
Please feel free to share your feedback through Discord, the Steam Community, or in the comments on this post.[/p][p]Thank you very much![/p]

notes.title: 0918 LootMage Patch Notes & 1-Week Launch Thank You
notes.notes:
[h3]Patch Notes[/h3][p]Main Changes[/p][list][*][p]After clearing a stage, if you collapse or end Early Access, you can obtain additional Mana Coins.[/p][/*][*][p]Added dungeon direction guide arrows in the village.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the NPC “Don the Storekeeper” in the village.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/149667284dc9f1066b2804d0a5c556917219a948.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]By paying Mana Coins, you can open a Loot Chest before starting your adventure.[/p][/*][/list][p]New Weapons[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/af46452a0793432e549c8b32313c0ce53e9162d0.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]Frost Wand: Fires an icy projectile.[/p][/*][*][p]Blossom Wand: Fires multiple homing projectiles.[/p][/*][/list][p]Bug Fixes[/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the frost summoned by the Frost Pom-Pom Fruit would not disappear after moving to another map and returning.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3]Developer’s Message[/h3][p][/p][p]Hello, this is CurlyMango, the developer of LootMage.
It has already been one week since LootMage launched in Early Access on September 11.[/p][p]Thanks to everyone who played and shared feedback, we were able to release continuous patches during the past week.
LootMage will continue to improve and grow through communication with you. The full release is also being prepared with care.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your continued support, and please feel free to share your thoughts on Discord, the Steam Community, or in the comments on this post.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: 0916 LootMage Patch Notes
notes.notes:
[list][*][p]Fixed an issue where shop items were incorrectly sold at a multiplied price from the previous run.[/p][/*][*][p]Some shop item prices have been adjusted.[/p][/*][*][p]For a certain period of time, melee weapons will not appear in weapon loot chests. (However, they can still be purchased from shops.)[/p][/*][*][p]The base attack speed and projectile speed of Wands and Staves have been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Contact damage is disabled during enemy summoning. During this time, the player will not take melee damage from enemies, and enemies will not attack the player. However, the player’s attacks will still apply normally to enemies.[/p][/*][*][p]Some weapon item options have been adjusted:[/p][list][*][p]Lapis Wand: Damage 10 → 12[/p][/*][*][p]Verdant Branch: Damage 10 → 12[/p][/*][*][p]Priest’s Wand: Damage 10 → 12[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][list][*][p]Developer’s Note
As mentioned in the previous announcement, we are prioritizing improvements to early-game pacing and melee weapon usability.
In this patch, we increased the average attack speed and projectile speed of Wands and Staves to improve early-game pacing. We also slightly increased the damage of three types of wands.
For melee weapons, until the improvement work is complete, they will not appear in loot chests and can only be obtained from shops.
Please feel free to share your feedback and suggestions on LootMage’s Discord, X, or Steam Community.
With your feedback and the developer’s dedication, LootMage will continue to evolve into a more polished game.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: LootMage Early Access Launch!
notes.notes:
[p]Hello, this is CurlyMango.[/p][p]As of September 11, LootMage has finally launched in Early Access on Steam!
Based on the feedback received during the demo period, the Early Access version now includes the tutorial along with three complete stages to play.[/p][p]This build includes the following content:[/p][list][*][p]Over 50 passive items[/p][/*][*][p]More than 10 Arc customization options[/p][/*][*][p]Synergy-based build-making[/p][/*][*][p]Procedurally generated dungeons and boss battles[/p][/*][/list][p]Your play and feedback will greatly help shape future updates.
Thank you for your interest and support![/p]

notes.title: LootMage Demo Deactivation
notes.notes: [p]As the content between the demo and the Early Access version has changed significantly, we will be releasing a new demo build in the future.[/p][p]The current demo will be deactivated before the Early Access launch.[/p][p]We kindly ask for your continued interest in the upcoming Early Access version of [i]LootMage[/i].[/p]

notes.title: LootMage launches in Early Access on September 11!
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/347c2e527946f603d8f0b48b234bed5a0e4b7245.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Hello, this is CurlyMango, the developer of LootMage.[/p][p]
We’re excited to announce that our magic bullet-hell roguelite LootMage will officially launch in Early Access on September 11, 2025.[/p][p]
In the Early Access version, you’ll be able to experience 3 full stages, face numerous enemies, and discover a wide variety of items.[/p][p]
During the Early Access period, we’ll continue improving the game based on your feedback and work toward making it even more polished.[/p][p]
Your interest and support mean a lot to us.[/p][p]
We hope you look forward to it![/p]

notes.title: 2025.07.02 LootMage Demo Hotfix
notes.notes:
[p][b]Village Button Change[/b]
The "Return to Village" button has been replaced with a "Return to Main Menu" button while in the village.[/p][p][b]Improved Resolution Compatibility[/b]
UI elements have been adjusted to display properly across various screen resolutions, not just 16:9.[/p][p][b]Loading Input Bug Fix[/b]
Fixed an issue where interacting with other buttons during game loading from the main menu could cause the game to freeze.[/p][p][b]Weapon Discard Icon Fix[/b]
Corrected an issue where the weapon discard icon was displayed incorrectly.[/p][p][/p][p]We appreciate your continued interest and support for LootMage as we prepare for its upcoming release![/p]

notes.title: 2025.06.23 LootMage Demo Minor Update
notes.notes:
[h2]UI Improvements[/h2][p]You can now check the number of synergies an item has [b]before picking it up[/b], via a UI displayed at the top of the screen.
This makes it easier to build your strategy more intuitively.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Demo Content Update[/h2][p]LootMage features the Arcane Tuner system, but since the demo only covers Stage 1, it was difficult to experience the full potential of Mana Stones.[/p][p]To address this, we've added an option to [b]start the game with 3 Mana Stones[/b].[/p][p]After defeating the Stage 1 boss, talk to the NPC [i]Kevin[/i] in front of the cave.
Later, you'll be able to meet him again in town, where you can start a run with 3 Mana Stones after speaking with him.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Bug Fixes[/h2][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where sound settings from the main menu were not applied properly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where BGM did not play correctly when entering the shop.[/p][/*][/list][p]Thank you as always for your support for LootMage.
If you encounter any bugs or have questions, feel free to reach out via [b]Discord[/b] or the [b]Steam Community[/b]![/p]

notes.title: 2025.2.25 LootMage Demo Small-Scale Update
notes.notes:
Are you enjoying Steam Next Fest?
Based on various feedback, LootMage has received a small-scale update!

-You can now see the mana cost of weapons that consume mana in the inventory.

-Hovering over an Insignia icon in the inventory will now display synergy information.
Additionally, you can hold down the mouse button on an artifact item to check its synergy effects. Be sure to take advantage of this in your gameplay!

-If you faint during your adventure, any Mana Shards you have will be converted into Experience.
Experience will be used in the full release to permanently upgrade player stats.


How was your short adventure in the LootMage demo?

Please submit your suggestions, improvements, and bug reports
on the Community Hub or Discord!

We appreciate all feedback. Thank you!

notes.title: LootMage Store Now Open!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45438133/eab37d476f8cbb045af5d5954c154a0353e9ee57.png[/img]



Greetings! The store page and community hub for LootMage are now open.

LootMage is a magical bullet hell, action roguelite game set in a medieval fantasy world. As an adventurer, players must fight against enemies in ever-changing dungeons, collect treasures, and survive the challenges.

We plan to release the game trailer and demo in mid-February and participate in the Steam Next Fest later that month. We look forward to your continued interest and support!
